purpose: Controlled edge-case & real-document hardening corpus for Research Paper Analyzer Phase 1

standard_academic.notes: 8-page journal academic paper in cloud security & encryption.

journal.notes: Contains Journal of Science and Technology ISSN, Volume, Issue, DOI, Abstract, Keywords, and Figures 1-3.

thesis.notes: 160-page academic thesis with 382 chunks, ToC/List-of-Figures pages, Roman & Arabic pages, tables, and numerical datasets.

technical_report.notes: Real capstone/engineering report resembling paper structure; also used to test manual override.

project_report.notes: Real engineering project report DOCX with sample counts and system modules.

ieee_two_column.notes: No real IEEE two-column PDF in dev DB; synthetic fixture covers Roman sections (I-V), lettered subsections (A/B), two-column interleaved text, Index Terms, DOI, copyright footnote, and experimental table/metrics.

acm_style.notes: No real ACM PDF in dev DB; synthetic fixture covers ACM CCS CONCEPTS, uppercase unpunctuated headings (1 INTRODUCTION), ACM Reference Format footnote, and p-values/CIs.

conference.notes: No standalone conference proceedings PDF in dev DB; covered via synthetic conference fixture with Proceedings metadata, baselines, and comparisons.

toc_heavy.notes: Combines real 160-page thesis front-matter ToC (doc #5) with synthetic dotted leaders, spaced-dot leaders, Roman page refs, and collapsed multi-entry ToC strings.

tables_and_metrics.notes: Tests experimental metrics (accuracy, F1, precision, recall, latency, sample counts, p-values, CIs, comparisons) vs structural numbers (Section 3.2, Figure 4, Table 2, Eq. 5, [18], Page 12, 2024).

figure_references.notes: Tests Figure 1, Fig. 2, Figure 3(a), Table 1, Table II, Algorithm 1, Eq. (4), Equation 5 while verifying visual_parsing_limitation disclosure.

missing_fields.notes: Tests papers lacking hypothesis, dataset, limitations, future work, affiliation, or venue so missing fields return 'Not explicitly stated in the paper.'.
